description: This file contains unit tests for the ConfigStore component in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing remote and local load/save behaviors.

classes.name: ConfigStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for ConfigStore, verifying load and save behaviors in remote and local modes.

methods.name: load uses remote in remote mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load correctly uses remote config in remote mode.

methods.name: load uses local in local mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.load correctly uses local config in local mode.

methods.name: save routes to remote in remote mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.save correctly routes to remote when in remote mode.

methods.name: save routes to local in local mode
methods.description: Tests that ConfigStore.save correctly routes to local when in local mode.
